All operations are confined to the build directory and the package directory, with no attempts to access sensitive files, exfiltrate data, or modify system state outside of the intended installation. The maintainers and contributors are listed in standard format, and there are no obfuscated commands or suspicious scripts. The behavior is consistent with legitimate packaging of a Perl module.
